TMO.headline: Argus Research Maintains Buy on Thermo Fisher Scientific, Raises Price Target to $780
Evercore ISI Adjusts Thermo Fisher Scientific Price Target
TMO.summary: Evercore ISI has revised its price target for Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., lowering it from $720 to $615.

TMO.headline: 15-year-old wins top award at 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge
TMO.summary: A 15-year-old student received the $25,000 top prize in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge for developing a low-cost device to monitor airborne bacteria.

TMO.headline: Thermo Fisher Scientific Experts to Host Webinar on Clario Endpoint Data Solutions
TMO.summary: Experts from the Thermo Fisher Scientific team supporting Clario Endpoint Data Solutions are scheduled to host a live webinar on November 10, 2026.
